input.question: After what time do women get a security escort on drops?

actual.answer: A security escort is required for any drop scheduled after 8:00 PM when a female employee is on board. The escort must be a trained security personnel provided by the cab vendor carrying a photo identity card.

input.question: How many hours before my trip do I need to book it?

actual.answer: You must make a new booking at least 4 hours before the scheduled pickup or drop time.

input.question: Who approves an airport trip?

actual.answer: An airport trip must be approved in advance by the employee's Transport Manager in the MoveInSync app.

input.question: Is company transport available on Saturdays?

actual.answer: No, company transport is not provided on Saturdays. This applies to all grades and shifts.

input.question: What is the cost cap for a regular trip?

actual.answer: The cost cap for a regular rostered trip is INR 800 per employee per trip. This cap applies to the employee's share of a shared cab, not the full fare.

input.question: Can I bring a guest in the company cab?

actual.answer: Yes, visitors, interview candidates, and employees from other Acme offices may travel as guests. You are responsible for the guest for the whole trip, and guests are not allowed on any drop that requires a security escort.

input.question: I'm a lady leaving office at 9:30 at night. Will there be a guard in my cab?

actual.answer: Yes, a trained security escort will travel in the cab with you because your drop is scheduled after 8:00 PM. The escort is provided by the cab vendor and must carry a photo identity card.

input.question: If I skip my cab two times this month, what happens to me?

actual.answer: If you are suspended more than once in any three-month period, you are reported to your reporting manager. You may appeal a no-show in the app within 3 days if the cab arrived at the wrong location or was more than 15 minutes late.

input.question: What's the latest I can call off tonight's pickup without getting penalised?

actual.answer: You must cancel at least 2 hours before the trip to avoid a no-show penalty. Cancellations made less than 2 hours before the trip are considered a no-show.

input.question: I'm an L8 manager. Can I use the office cab?

actual.answer: No, employees in grade L7 and above are not eligible for company cabs. Instead, you receive a monthly travel allowance through payroll.

input.question: My house is only 3 km from the office. Am I allowed company transport?

actual.answer: No, you are not eligible because company transport requires a home address at least 5 km from the office.

input.question: Who pays when my share of the cab fare goes over the limit?

actual.answer: If your share of the trip exceeds the INR 800 cap, the excess amount is recovered from your salary at the end of the month. You will be notified in the app before any deduction is made.

input.question: Do tolls and parking count towards the limit on ad-hoc trips?

actual.answer: No, toll and parking charges are paid on top of the INR 1,500 cap for a single ad-hoc trip.

input.question: What are all the safety arrangements for women on night drops?

actual.answer: For drops after 8:00 PM, a trained security escort with a vendor ID card must travel in the cab, and the employee cannot be the first pickup or last drop. The driver must wait for the employee to confirm arrival in the app, and if no confirmation is received within 10 minutes, the command centre calls her and alerts local security if she is unreachable.

input.question: How do guest bookings work and who is responsible for the guest during the trip?

actual.answer: The host employee must raise a request in the app at least 24 hours before the trip with the guest's details and obtain approval from the Transport Manager. The host is responsible for the guest for the whole trip, and guests are not allowed on drops requiring a security escort.

input.question: What counts as a no-show and what is the penalty for it?

actual.answer: A no-show occurs if you do not board within 5 minutes of the cab's arrival or cancel less than 2 hours before the trip. Being a no-show twice in a calendar month results in a one-week suspension from company transport starting the following Monday, during which you must arrange your own travel at your own cost.

input.question: If I cancel my drop one hour before, will I be suspended?

actual.answer: Cancelling one hour before the drop is treated as a no-show, which counts towards the limit in Section 9. The provided excerpts do not specify the exact number of no-shows required for suspension, so it is not clear if this single instance will result in suspension.

input.question: My manager asked me to come in on Sunday. How do I get there and how much can I claim back?

actual.answer: You must arrange your own travel and claim the cost through the reimbursement portal within 30 days. The claim requires your manager's written approval and the trip receipt, and is paid up to the regular trip cap in Section 7.

input.question: The vendor cancelled my cab at the last minute because of a breakdown. Will it count against me, and can I claim the taxi I took?

actual.answer: No, a company cancellation due to a vehicle breakdown never counts as a no-show. You may claim the cost of your alternative travel up to the ad-hoc trip limit in Section 6.

input.question: Can an intern take a company cab to the airport for an official trip?

actual.answer: No, interns are not eligible for airport trips. They are only eligible for drops at the end of a night shift that ends at or after 11:00 PM.

input.question: What if I don't turn up for my cab three times in a month?

actual.answer: Three no-shows in a calendar month result in a written warning sent to you and your manager. The no-show count resets on the first day of every month.

input.question: I'm a vice president. Am I still allowed to use the shuttle?

input.question: Can I set up my bookings once for the whole month?

input.question: I shifted homes last week. Where will the cab pick me up?
